semanticNotes.en: A source-specific archaeological period definition. Its dates classify source material; they do not define a polity, ancestry, continuous population or civilization origin. Approximate and competing chronologies remain possible.
semanticNotes.zh-CN: 特定来源对考古时期的定义。日期用于组织来源材料，不表示政权、继承、人口连续性或文明起源。近似日期及竞争纪年保持为可能适用。

rules: Civil BC/AD numbering has no year zero.
An explicit c./ca./circa/around qualification makes the derived extent possible.
An ordinal century is retained as its full civil century, with no invented mid-century cutoff.
Distinct explicit source chronology alternatives remain separately qualified assertions.
No missing endpoint is borrowed from another hypothesis, page or period.
